parts.text: Hi, my name is Alex and I am a software developer living in Seoul. I usually work from home 3 days a week, and on the other days I go to an office near Gangnam Station. In my free time I like to go jogging along the Han River, especially in the early morning when the air is fresh. After jogging, I usually make a simple breakfast with eggs and toast. Last weekend, I went to a small cafe with my friends. We talked about our trip to Busan last summer. We ate a lot of seafood and we walked on the beach until midnight. It was one of the best trips I have ever had. I took so many pictures that my phone ran out of storage. These days, I am trying to improve my English speaking skills because I want to work with people from other countries. I practice every evening for about 30 minutes, and I think my confidence is getting better little by little. My goal is to get a good score on my speaking test next month
